name: 螺蛳牌楼 Luosi Pailou
line: Modelled from plate 19 of 1783-86, drawn frontally; the plan draws only an ornamental figure and no photograph of it is in hand, so every figure is a reading (C) on a weak module.
rows: 22.9 m wide (plate 19 on the dossier's weak module, C): the arch 2.82 m wide to 5.77 m between two free columns, a square-headed door 1.25 × 3.55 m either side under a shell, the end bays with their panels; four columns 5.2 m, the carved vines over the piers and round the shafts (S02 p.159)

the wavy cornice at 6.9 m over the outer columns and 6.6 m over the inner ones, rising to 7.36 m over the arch; the attic with its broken scroll pediment (8.5 m) and the trophy group (10.7 m), trophies over the columns, the end urns (plate 19, C)
a tower over each side bay, 3.05 m square: a body with scrolls and a cartouche, a flared cornice at 9.1 m, a concave pyramidal cap, a lantern and an urn to 12 m (plate 19, C)
the depth (3 m), the east face, the ends, the passages and the side rooms, carried round from the west front (C, the pale tint with conf=1)
